justification: The main correspondence is that both surfaces include a schematic anthropomorphic figure with facial features and some circular/linear motifs worked into the design. The biggest difference is iconographic: A shows a standing profile figure apparently holding a vertical staff or standard within a framed scene, while B shows a frontal, mask-like or torso-like figure dominated by large facial/body features and bands, with no comparable held object or narrative arrangement.
